_comment: Constants shared by the JAX training code (training/zero) and the TypeScript port (packages/ai/src/zero). Change them here only. Tile definitions come from the engine (training/zero/tiles.json is exported from it).

env._comment: maxPly: turns before a game is a draw. pending: no tile in hand / a draw not yet revealed. bagFeatureScale: bag counts are divided by this in the network input.

actions._comment: Direction order in the action numbering: commands use dirs8 (source, destination), placements use dirs4. (dRow, dCol) in the canonical frame.

search._comment: Defaults for training and the browser; an exported model's .json records the settings its run used. valueScale and maxvisitInit: completed-Q weight (50 + max visits) * valueScale. chanceTieTolerance: chance outcomes this close count as tied (lowest outcome wins). valueScale is pi/10: anything from 0.2 to 1.0 beat 0.1 (EXPERIMENTS.md, value_scale sweep).
